head_indexing: Zero-based layer and query-head indices; cumulative order transcribed from paper Figure S2.
paper: Tracing Mechanisms of Sycophantic Agreement in Language Models

dataset.name: cais/mmlu
dataset.selection: From the 15 paper subjects and questions of at most 1000 characters: clean ABCD argmax correct; every label/content swap favors its newly correct label over the original label; at least one wrong-label opinion favors its target over the correct label. Choose the wrong target minimizing correct-minus-target logit difference (first-index tie break). Selection uses the paper prompt; never reselect for adjusted prompts.
